column1: # Golden bucket classification, captured from scripts/changed-buckets.sh as it stood at commit
# 2b2c3a3 (PR #49) - the bash implementation this package replaces.
# It is here because the parity check that produced it can only be run once: the script is
# deleted in the same change that adds this file. Each row was produced by building a throwaway
# git repository with a genuine `refs/pull/N/merge`-shaped merge commit touching exactly those
# paths, running the real script against it with GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request, and recording
# what it wrote to $GITHUB_OUTPUT. That is the same path the CI job takes, not a re-reading of
# The bash was validated on two real pull requests before it was frozen: on #49 it correctly hit
# the force-everything rule (a .github/** file was touched) and on #50, a renovate.json-only
# change, it correctly reported every bucket false.
# Format: <paths, | separated><TAB><bucket=value,...>. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Paths under scripts/ are deliberately absent: that directory does not survive this change.
# TestMovedScriptsOnlyEverRunMore covers them instead, asserting that each replacement path
# under tools/ classifies at least as widely as the script it replaced.
